title: 85C7L TCL 85" SQD-Mini LED 4K UHD Google TV (2026) $2,150 + Delivery ($0 to Select Areas/ NSW C&C/ in-Store) @ Appliance Central
body:
Deal: 85C7L TCL 85" SQD-Mini LED 4K UHD Google TV (2026) $2,150 + Delivery ($0 to Select Areas/ NSW C&C/ in-Store) @ Appliance Central

[Remorhaz] This or the 85" C8L for $2795 or the Samsung 85" R85H for $2850?
[PriceDropProphet] Depends on your need/want. This is all you want is a great tv and you’re not seeking the absolute best mini led. C8L is you want an extra, say 15-20% greater experience. Don’t know a lot about the Samsung but the TCL’s are leading the pack for mini-led and are unbelievable value for what you get. I’ve got the C7K and still can’t believe how great it is for the price I paid almost 2 years ago
[Kangal] Specs look great…. but what makes/breaks these LCD TVs is the amount of backlight they have. Look at the LED Count, and be ready to buy an older model if it has significantly more backlighting.
[team teri] This price is virtually the same with the 20% off deals currently on at other retailers. And yes, it is my choice of TV too. A lot better than the entry level model, marginally less good than the top of the range. Diminishing returns for the dollars.
FYI: last week I had a bit of a bargaining chat with a JB HiFi sales person. This one was offered at $2300, the C8L for $2800, both with free delivery.
I expect I'll walk out with it for about $2000 when I hit the shops tomorrow.
[OzzyOzbourne] Don't forget, when TV's are cheap, you are the product
[speedyjonzalas] They are really decent tvs. I have the 65 version its really good
[BargainBuddy] Precisely. You’re essentially the product because you sell your usage data for advertising. However, for an additional $300, you can purchase an Nvidia Shield TV and use it as a basic monitor, effectively bypassing the TV company that collects your data.
[raj9744] Is it better than c8k ?
I liked c8k the most ( the ones I have seen in real life at stores), and I was hoping to have c8k on sale someday
[neverpayfull] No. C7L is newer version of C7K and C8L has taken over C8K.
Only few stores might have C8K available now
